 The NBA slate on Thursday, which includes the Dallas Mavericks squaring off against the Minnesota Timberwolves, is not one to miss.
 Seeking additional betting info for Thursday's NBA action? We have you covered with odds for each of the important games in the article below.
 Philadelphia 76ers vs. Toronto Raptors
 Projected Favorite: 76ers (56.51% win probability)
 Spread: 76ers (-6.5)
 Total: 223.5
 Moneyline: 76ers -275, Raptors +225
 Time: 7:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: Sportsnet, SN+, NBCS-PH, PCK-PHI
 Bet on Philadelphia 76ers vs. Toronto Raptors with FanDuel Sportsbook.
